text: A fresh macOS machine. Everything in this run is fake: a made-up shop, a test account and a scripted chat.
Open the downloaded disk image, as a new user would
Copy Valet Demo into Applications (the script copies it; a person drags the icon)
Installed. This test build is unsigned and was never downloaded, so Gatekeeper does not ask about it
First launch. (Started with a debugging port that only this demo build accepts, so the script can drive it)
Valet opens its first-run setup
Where logins come from. In the demo, a test provider stands in for 1Password
Review the shop adapter: the sites it may reach, and what each tool can do
Approve it. Until now its tools were hidden from every chat client
Let the adapter use the login, typed only into the shop’s sign-in page
The shop texts a code at sign-in, so let Valet read that one sender’s codes (here from the fake’s outbox, not Messages)
Prices and stock follow a store, so pick the pick-up store the tools shop at
Connect a chat app. Valet gives it a config that starts its own bridge, with no token in it
Now a chat app. This one is a scripted stand-in for Claude that speaks real MCP
Paste the config Valet copied
Connected through Valet’s bridge: 6 tools
The agent searches the shop through Valet. Searching needs no login
Valet spaces the shop’s requests 10 to 15 seconds apart, so this is unhurried on purpose
Valet answers at once that it is logging in, and the agent calls again when told
Valet: an earlier call still holds the shop's turn. Call again in 10 s.
Valet: an earlier call still holds the shop's turn. Call again in 10 s.
The agent reads the trolley back
Back in Valet: every call, and the login, is in its audited activity log
Now the shopper opens the shop’s website to check out
Sign in on the shop’s own login page (a stand-in for its Auth0 page), with the test account
The shop texts a code. A test phone page shows it
The trolley holds what the agent added through Valet
Checkout: pick up today. The person places the order; Valet’s MVP never does
Order 100000001 placed
Back in the chat, the agent can see the trolley is empty now
End of the demo
